Include condition:null when unconditional; output_refs:["NODE_ID:result"] for every node. input_refs is exactly the unique parameter reference values, not dependency outputs unless a parameter uses them. REPORT/JOIN parameters:{} and input_refs:[]; dependencies automatically collect results. failure_policy:{"mode":"STOP","max_retries":0}. Do not omit any required field. If impossible or underspecified return {"schema_version":1,"nodes":[]} (validator rejects). Financial proposals need separate later approval. No parallel writes.
